entries.name: resource_tile_decoder_iwram
entries.evidence: Same entry as revision 0: Matching installer 0x08016a48 publishes destination 0x030036d0 to callback word 0x03003360; source/destination/control literals establish the 528-byte copy. The first 504 ROM bytes are matching C resource_decode_tile_runs; the following 24 bytes are a partial copy of separately matching C frame_stage_map_tiles; this adds no source credit or incoming-entry proof.

entries.name: resource_background_decoder_iwram
entries.evidence: Same entry as revision 0: Matching installer 0x08016a48 publishes destination 0x03003370 to callback word 0x030036c0; source/destination/control literals establish the 848-byte copy. The first 812 ROM bytes are source-owned assembly-origin resource_background_decoder; the following 36 bytes belong to matching C frame_schedule.

entries.name: frame_map_draw_iwram
entries.evidence: Same entry as revision 0: Matching installer 0x08039e78 publishes even destination 0x03007160 to callback word 0x03001fc8. Source/destination/control literals establish the 336-byte copy: 320-byte matching C frame_stage_map_tiles plus 16 source bytes of matching C frame_transfer_map_tiles. Compatible one-argument source interface uses the low byte of view_index; complete index, writer and incoming-entry populations remain open.

entries.name: frame_map_scroll_iwram
entries.evidence: Same entry as revision 0: Matching installer 0x08039e78 publishes destination 0x03005e60 to callback word 0x03001fcc; source/destination/control literals establish the 228-byte copy. The first 216 bytes are matching C frame_transfer_map_tiles at its RAM link address; the following 12 ROM source bytes belong to matching C display_find_tile_run. View argument is narrowed to a byte; allowed indices remain unresolved.

entries.name: audio_sample_active_ram

limitations: Copy addresses and sizes are read from this ROM's own copy literals and checked by every pilot and build run. What each copy is, and the evidence for it, is recorded with the same copy name in config/rev0/ram-map.json.
